d: Davina and Nicky revisit a woman who was looking for her American Air Force father, and a woman searching for her birth mother and sister.

Drew road trips to Cornwall to for a major buying mission. In Penzance he haggles with a hoarder who owns a reclamation yard, before heading to the county's busiest auction house.

A hop across the Atlantic brings in rare whiskies and African artefacts. Then in Liverpool, Angus takes a risk with a veteran's unique dining set.
A couple of Sherlock Holmes fans sell silverware, costumes and books after a flood hit their home. Plus, will army swords score big at auction.
The team are called to investigate the Groundlings Theatre in Hampshire. A volunteer believes there are malevolent spirits trapped in the building.
